verdict.summary: The change makes the header-based Retry-After parser conform to the existing bounded float-or-None contract, delegates plan-snapshot's job-specific cap at the parser call site, and preserves the fail-closed fallback for absent, malformed, non-positive, and HTTP-date values. The cross-module mirror checks compare independent constants and regex metadata, while literal-backed parser tests prevent agreement-by-common-degeneration. Call-site tests exercise fractional waits, malformed input, explicit cap delegation, removal of a duplicate post-parse cap, return type, sentinel behavior, and the secondary-before-budget classification order. I found no correctness, soundness, security, or test-vacuity defect in the diff.
